meaning: citizens of a country; the people of a nation

senses.en: citizens of a country; the people of a nation

note: Used for the people as a whole (国民经济, 国民健康); for one person, 公民 is more common.

examples.zh: 这件事会影响全体国民。
examples.en: This will affect all citizens.

examples.zh: 国家应该关心国民的健康。
examples.en: A country should care about its people's health.

examples.zh: 他们是哪国国民？
examples.en: Which country are they citizens of?

meaning: zone; area; strip of land

senses.en: zone; area; strip of land

examples.zh: 这一地带经常下雨，出门要带伞。
examples.en: This area often has rain, so take an umbrella when you go out.

examples.zh: 山区地带的路不好走。
examples.en: The roads in the mountain zone are hard to travel.

examples.zh: 你知道这个地带安全吗？
examples.en: Do you know whether this area is safe?

meaning: to cough

senses.en: to cough

note: Usually 咳嗽; 咳 alone is common in speech, e.g. 咳了一声.

examples.zh: 他感冒了，一直在咳。
examples.en: He has a cold and keeps coughing.

examples.zh: 医生让我咳两声。
examples.en: The doctor asked me to cough twice.

examples.zh: 你晚上咳得厉害吗？
examples.en: Do you cough badly at night?

meaning: to raise one's head; to look up

senses.en: to raise one's head; to look up

note: Also means the name line on an invoice (发票抬头), which you will be asked for when you get a receipt.

examples.zh: 他抬头看了看钟。
examples.en: He looked up at the clock.

examples.zh: 请抬头，看这里。
examples.en: Please raise your head and look here.

examples.zh: 发票的抬头要写公司名字。
examples.en: The name line on the invoice should be the company name.

meaning: depth; (of ideas) profundity

senses.en: depth; (of ideas) profundity

note: Also a degree of progress: 深度睡眠 (deep sleep).

examples.zh: 这条河的深度是三米。
examples.en: This river is three meters deep.

examples.zh: 这篇文章很有深度。
examples.en: This article has real depth.

examples.zh: 你觉得这个问题的深度够吗？
examples.en: Do you think this question goes deep enough?

meaning: basis; grounds; (v.) to base on, according to

senses.en: basis; grounds; (v.) to base on, according to

note: Common in 根据/依据 + noun, 作为依据, 没有依据.

examples.zh: 你这样说有什么依据？
examples.en: What is your basis for saying that?

examples.zh: 医生依据检查结果开了药。
examples.en: The doctor prescribed medicine based on the test results.

examples.zh: 这些数据不能作为依据。
examples.en: These data cannot serve as a basis.

meaning: to expect, anticipate; expectation

senses.en: to expect, anticipate; expectation

note: Often 达到预期 / 比预期好 / 不如预期.

examples.zh: 今年的生意比预期好。
examples.en: This year’s business is better than expected.

examples.zh: 结果没有达到我们的预期。
examples.en: The result did not meet our expectations.

examples.zh: 公司预期下个月会变好。
examples.en: The company expects things to get better next month.

meaning: a plan, program; to plan out

senses.en: a plan, program; to plan out

examples.zh: 你对以后的工作有什么规划？
examples.en: What are your plans for your future work?

examples.zh: 城市正在规划新的公园。
examples.en: The city is planning a new park.

examples.zh: 我想先做一个学习规划。
examples.en: I want to make a study plan first.

meaning: adhesive tape; magnetic tape

senses.en: adhesive tape; magnetic tape

note: In daily life it means sticky tape for sealing boxes (透明胶带).

examples.zh: 帮我拿一卷胶带，好吗？
examples.en: Could you get me a roll of tape?

examples.zh: 这个箱子要用胶带封好。
examples.en: This box needs to be sealed with tape.

examples.zh: 办公室里没有胶带了。
examples.en: There is no tape left in the office.

meaning: to own, possess; to hold (a share or position)

senses.en: to own, possess; to hold (a share or position)

note: Often 占有率 (market share) and 占有 + 优势/地位.

examples.zh: 这家公司占有很大的市场。
examples.en: This company holds a large share of the market.

examples.zh: 他想占有所有的钱。
examples.en: He wants to keep all the money for himself.

examples.zh: 我们不应该占有别人的东西。
examples.en: We should not take possession of other people's things.

meaning: pearl

senses.en: pearl

examples.zh: 这件衣服上有很多珍珠。
examples.en: There are many pearls on this garment.

examples.zh: 妈妈给我买了一颗珍珠。
examples.en: Mom bought me a pearl.

examples.zh: 这里的珍珠贵不贵？
examples.en: Are pearls expensive here?

meaning: extremely; terrible, serious (often 得 + 不得了 as degree)

senses.en: extremely; terrible, serious (often 得 + 不得了 as degree)

note: Adj + 得不得了; or as an exclamation of alarm: 不得了了！

examples.zh: 今天热得不得了，我不想出门。
examples.en: It is awfully hot today and I don't want to go out.

examples.zh: 孩子发烧了，真不得了！
examples.en: The child has a fever, this is serious!

examples.zh: 她高兴得不得了。
examples.en: She was extremely happy.

meaning: to be able to; so that (it becomes possible)

senses.en: to be able to; so that (it becomes possible)

note: Formal; follows a cause and is followed by a verb: 经过努力，问题得以解决.

examples.zh: 经过大家的努力，问题得以解决。
examples.en: Thanks to everyone's effort, the problem was solved.

examples.zh: 有了你的帮助，我才得以完成工作。
examples.en: With your help I was able to finish the work.

examples.zh: 有了新路，大家得以很快到学校。
examples.en: With the new road, everyone can get to school quickly.

meaning: the outside world; external (circles)

senses.en: the outside world; external (circles)

examples.zh: 他很少和外界联系。
examples.en: He rarely has contact with the outside world.

examples.zh: 这件事外界还不知道。
examples.en: The outside world doesn't know about this yet.

examples.zh: 别让外界的声音影响你。
examples.en: Don't let outside voices affect you.

meaning: (of vehicles) to travel along a route; to drive

senses.en: (of vehicles) to travel along a route; to drive

note: Used for vehicles and ships on a road or route; 行驶速度 = travel speed.

examples.zh: 汽车在高速公路上行驶。
examples.en: The car is traveling on the highway.

examples.zh: 请注意，车辆要在右边行驶。
examples.en: Please note: vehicles must drive on the right.

examples.zh: 下雨的时候行驶要慢一点儿。
examples.en: Drive a bit slower when it rains.

meaning: to hand over; to pass (something to someone)

senses.en: to hand over; to pass (something to someone)

examples.zh: 请把那本书递给我。
examples.en: Please hand me that book.

examples.zh: 他递给我一杯水。
examples.en: He handed me a glass of water.

examples.zh: 你能递一下那张纸吗？
examples.en: Can you pass me that sheet of paper?

meaning: to demonstrate; to show how it is done; a model example

senses.en: to demonstrate; to show how it is done; a model example

examples.zh: 老师先给我们示范了一遍。
examples.en: The teacher first demonstrated it once for us.

examples.zh: 你能示范一下怎么用吗？
examples.en: Can you show me how to use it?

examples.zh: 他的做法是一个好示范。
examples.en: His approach is a good model.

meaning: before, previously, earlier

senses.en: before, previously, earlier

examples.zh: 他比先前瘦了很多。
examples.en: He is much thinner than before.

examples.zh: 先前我不知道这件事。
examples.en: I didn't know about this earlier.

examples.zh: 这里和先前完全不一样了。
examples.en: This place is completely different from before.

meaning: to regard as; to mistake for

senses.en: to regard as; to mistake for

note: 把 A 看成 B means to take A for B, either as a view or a misreading.

examples.zh: 别把我看成客人。
examples.en: Don’t treat me as a guest.

examples.zh: 我把三看成了五。
examples.en: I mistook a three for a five.

examples.zh: 你怎么把他看成坏人了？
examples.en: How did you come to see him as a bad person?

meaning: hard, arduous (of conditions or life)

senses.en: hard, arduous (of conditions or life)

note: Describes conditions and effort: 艰苦的环境, 艰苦奋斗; not for simply "difficult" tasks.

examples.zh: 山区的生活条件很艰苦。
examples.en: Living conditions in the mountains are harsh.

examples.zh: 他们在艰苦的环境中工作。
examples.en: They work in harsh conditions.

examples.zh: 过去的日子艰苦吗？
examples.en: Were the past days hard?
